{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check if any revenue values are suspiciously high (e.g. 999999.99)
high_revenue = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of suspicious high-revenue rows: {len(high_revenue)}")
print(high_revenue[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'status', 'revenue', 'revenue_clean']])"}
